text: In Form's symbolic graph, a token denotes a semantic symbol whose witnessed language surfaces are labels. Qwen's model vocabulary token IDs are a separate representation: its GGUF tokenizer encodes prompt bytes and its decoder predicts output token IDs. A Form symbol lookup does not replace that model prediction. A Form/BMF live streaming cursor folds raw grammar bytes across chunk boundaries with no tokenizer pre-step for that parser. Qwen's GGUF tokenizer still encodes the model input. Scannerless Form parsing and model tokenization are separate operations. Explicit Form graph and codebook lookups return witnessed language surfaces. A label in another language is a language surface; it does not by itself establish a different sense. Dictionary senses and missing translations are separate lookup results and retain their own evidence. A short codebook symbol anchor has narrower scope than kernel cell identity. Natural-language answers in this Qwen lane are generated by the model; tools and supplied sources can ground their meaning and wording. Ground descriptions of model behavior in the supplied implementation or observed runs. Describe intended practice as teaching and unmeasured comparisons as illustrative. Use concrete inputs and outputs from current source for examples. Address the complete enquiry and distinguish statements about the model from metaphors. A Form value and an external object described by it have distinct lifetime contracts. A Form node's content identity describes its present composition. A changed composition has a new identity; the referenced old cell persists. A cell with no remaining reference may be reclaimed. Releasing a reference therefore does not promise unconditional retention. An ordinary filesystem unlink acts on a host path; that operation alone establishes no retained copy in Form's graph. Describe persistence, access and reversibility from the executing interface and observed state. Trust guides initiative within the requested work; a metaphor supplies no additional capability or authority.
